trim.summary: Trimming is not part of the current Cephalon support contract.

nativeAot.summary: Native AOT is not part of the current Cephalon support contract.

singleFile.summary: Single-file publishing is not part of the current Cephalon support contract.

representativePublishTargets.comment: List the smallest set of csproj paths the harness should publish to honestly prove a claim. The harness defaults to this list when -PublishTargets is not passed and -SkipPublish is not set; pass -SkipPublish to force audit-only mode. Each target is published once per deployment mode (trim / nativeAot / singleFile); the audit-only verdict reports warnings but does not fail the build because the manifest still declares all three modes as not-claimed.

deploymentModeEligibility.comment: Per-package eligibility table seeded from docs/trim-aot-hazard-inventory.md. Originally introduced via ENG-426 (high + first medium-tier seeding); broadened via ENG-432 (Cephalon.Behaviors.Http reclassified low->medium with three additional reflection sites), ENG-433 (Cephalon.Data added at medium tier under broadened MakeGenericMethod / BindingFlags pattern set), ENG-434 (Cephalon.Data.MySql added at high tier + Cephalon.Data.Postgres / Cephalon.Data.Oracle added at medium tier for the CDC capture services), ENG-435 (Cephalon.Abstractions added at low tier + two enum-extension hazard sites appended to Cephalon.Behaviors.Http), ENG-436 (six additional knownHazards entries appended to Cephalon.Behaviors covering the BehaviorModule.cs two-phase auto-registration pipeline + the BehaviorExecutionSlot.cs open-generic execution-slot dispatch — package tier unchanged at high, hazard list grows), ENG-437 (seven additional knownHazards entries appended to Cephalon.Behaviors.Http covering RestBehaviorProjection.cs reflective method lookup + open-generic dispatch, RestBehaviorModuleBuilder.cs IBehaviorModuleBuilder.Add overload selection + open-generic dispatch, and BehaviorRestProfileResolver.cs phase-1 ContainsBehaviorsAttribute.RegistrationType reflective enumerators — package tier unchanged at medium, hazard list grows from 6 to 13), ENG-438 (Cephalon.ReferenceDocs added at high tier with a permanent not-claimed posture — the published documentation generator performs by-design type-introspection of arbitrary referenced assemblies, so the high-tier remediation alternative "document a permanent not-claimed posture for that package" is the durable answer rather than a structural rewrite — closing the last item in the original ENG-433 not-yet-classified callout), ENG-439 (Cephalon.ReferenceDocs csproj posture uplift — declared IsTrimmable=false / IsAotCompatible=false / PublishTrimmed=false / PublishAot=false / PublishSingleFile=false in src/Cephalon.ReferenceDocs/Cephalon.ReferenceDocs.csproj and seeded the matching requiredProjectProperties array in this manifest entry, so the harness's project-property audit phase can confirm the permanent posture in machine-checkable form), ENG-454 (schema 1.2.0 package-scoped claim pilot — Cephalon.Diagnostics is the first clean-baseline package with supportedModes=[singleFile] and required project properties that the harness treats as scoped support rather than global support drift), ENG-456 (retired all nine REST wire-name enum-field reflection helpers by replacing attribute reflection with closed switch mappings; Cephalon.Abstractions returned to clean-baseline absence from this table and Cephalon.Behaviors.Http dropped the two enum-extension hazards while retaining its medium-tier dispatch hazards), ENG-457 (Cephalon.Behaviors.SourceGen now emits execution-slot hints and Cephalon.Behaviors prefers them for source-generated dispatch startup, while this manifest also records the new GetExecutionSlots carrier-method lookup and keeps the package at high because generated carrier lookups plus runtime discovery fallback remain), ENG-458 (Cephalon.Behaviors.SourceGen now emits closed durable-execution slots and Cephalon.Behaviors.Patterns prefers them for source-generated durable strategy/catalog paths), ENG-459 (Cephalon.Data.MySql now projects hosted-service capture failure metadata through a typed internal failure-metadata contract instead of duck-typed property reflection, while the package stays high because the SciSharp ReplicationClient non-public adapter remains), ENG-460 (Cephalon.Data.Postgres and Cephalon.Data.Oracle now project CDC hosted-service capture failure metadata through provider-local typed internal contracts, removing the remaining duck-typed CDC exception metadata rows), ENG-461 (the Cephalon.EventSourcing provider family now persists stable registry event-type names and resolves legacy names through EventTypeDescriptor aliases, removing all ten persisted Type.GetType rows), ENG-462 (core Cephalon.Data read/write stores now use registered command/query dispatch descriptors instead of runtime MethodInfo lookup, MakeGenericMethod, or CreateDelegate), ENG-463 (Cephalon.Behaviors.Http route mapping, projection application, and REST module ownership now use type-based runtime contracts instead of MethodInfo.MakeGenericMethod/Invoke dispatch), ENG-464 (Cephalon.Behaviors.Http generated REST profile hints now register through a module-initializer registry and result-envelope OpenAPI metadata uses descriptor metadata instead of runtime ResultModel<> MakeGenericType, while the row now records the remaining fallback/manual-route reflection truth), ENG-465 (Cephalon.Behaviors source-generated module registration now flows through BehaviorGeneratedModuleRegistry rather than ContainsBehaviorsAttribute carrier-method lookup, retiring the four generated-carrier rows while keeping the runtime discovery and open-generic fallback hazards truthful), ENG-466 (Cephalon.Behaviors.Http generated-profile mapping now requires registry hints and no longer falls back to scanning the owning module assembly), ENG-467 (Cephalon.Behaviors.Patterns removes DurableExecutionSlot.ForType and reclassifies the package from high to medium by recording the remaining saga choreography runtime-catalog interface/result-shape reflection instead of the retired durable open-generic fallback), ENG-468 (Cephalon.Behaviors.Patterns moves saga choreography runtime-catalog shape into source-generated or explicit SagaChoreographyRuntimeSlot registrations and returns to clean-baseline absence from this table), ENG-469 (Cephalon.Behaviors auto-registration now consumes BehaviorGeneratedModuleRegistry hints only and no longer falls back to scanning assembly.DefinedTypes for AppBehavior types), and ENG-470 (Cephalon.Behaviors no longer invokes static ConfigureTopology at runtime; generated auto-registration requires generated topology descriptors or explicit registration and fails fast for unsupported topology declarations). Each entry records the package's claim-audit tier, the actual reflection / dynamic-code call sites observed in its src/Cephalon.* source as of May 6, 2026, and the supportedModes that are explicitly scoped to that package. Entries with empty supportedModes do not claim a mode. The global manifest claim stays not-claimed until project properties + harness verdicts move for the whole engine support story. Packages absent from this table remain clean-baseline but unclaimed unless they are added here deliberately. Excluded-by-design analyzer / source-generator projects are listed separately so the harness can confirm their disable-properties remain in place.

knownHazards.remediation: Replace assembly-scanned module discovery with a compile-time module manifest emitted by a source generator that registers IModule descriptors at startup.

knownHazards.pattern: Runtime registry keyed by Type with late-bound resolution from descriptors
knownHazards.remediation: Replace runtime type registry with a compile-time descriptor + source-generator-emitted registration table; behaviors register via generated code rather than reflective discovery.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(BehaviorExecutionSlot).GetMethod(nameof(For), BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)!.MakeGenericMethod(behaviorType, tIn, tOut) followed by forMethod.Invoke(null, null) (line 76) — open-generic method dispatch over the (behaviorType, TInput, TOutput) triple drawn from the runtime registry; after ENG-457 this is the fallback path for behaviors without generated execution-slot hints
knownHazards.remediation: ENG-457 moved source-generated dispatch startup to generated closed generic For<TBehavior, TInput, TOutput>() slots. Remaining remediation is to retire the fallback by replacing BehaviorTypeRegistry and non-generated behavior registrations with source-generated or explicit execution-slot descriptors. The comparable Behaviors.Http route-dispatch row was retired by ENG-463 through type-based endpoint contracts.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(ReplicationClient).GetMethod(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic) — resolver behind 5 static MethodInfo fields (lines 21-24) targeting non-public members of the third-party SciSharp.MySQL.Replication.ReplicationClient type
knownHazards.remediation: Either an upstream SciSharp.MySQL.Replication API surface change that opens these members, or a fully public re-implementation of the binlog transport against the public API; annotation alone cannot reach across an external compiled assembly.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(ReplicationClient).GetMethod(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy) — resolver behind the SetupConnection static MethodInfo field (line 25)
knownHazards.remediation: Same upstream-API or public-rewrite path as the line-1177 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(ReplicationClient).GetField(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic) — resolver behind 3 static FieldInfo fields (lines 26-28: _connection, _serverId, _stream)
knownHazards.remediation: Same upstream-API or public-rewrite path; non-public fields on a third-party type cannot be preserved by trim/AOT analyzers.

knownHazards.pattern: method.Invoke(instance, arguments) over the resolved third-party non-public methods
knownHazards.remediation: Removed by the same upstream-API or public-rewrite that retires the GetMethod/GetField calls above; trim-hostile because the resolved methods themselves can be stripped from the third-party assembly.

packages.evidence: docs/trim-aot-hazard-inventory.md (high tier — third-party non-public reflective access remains; ENG-459 removed the hosted-service duck-typed capture failure metadata fallback)

knownHazards.pattern: type.GetConstructors(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly) over an arbitrary runtime Type parameter — by-design enumeration of the public-and-static constructors of any type the generator is asked to document, used to emit per-constructor MemberPage entries
knownHazards.remediation: Permanent not-claimed posture for the package (the high-tier remediation alternative). The package's purpose is type-introspection of arbitrary referenced assemblies, so a source-generator-emitted descriptor table cannot replace this reflection without removing the package's reason to exist. A future slice may declare IsTrimmable=false; IsAotCompatible=false; PublishTrimmed=false; PublishAot=false; PublishSingleFile=false in the csproj to make the permanent posture machine-checkable through the harness's project-property audit phase.

knownHazards.pattern: type.GetFields(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly) over an arbitrary runtime Type parameter — by-design enumeration of the public-and-static fields, used to emit per-field MemberPage entries
knownHazards.remediation: Same permanent not-claimed posture as the line-295 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: type.GetProperties(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly) over an arbitrary runtime Type parameter — by-design enumeration of the public-and-static properties, used to emit per-property MemberPage entries
knownHazards.remediation: Same permanent not-claimed posture as the line-295 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: type.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly) over an arbitrary runtime Type parameter — by-design enumeration of the public-and-static methods, used to emit per-method MemberPage entries
knownHazards.remediation: Same permanent not-claimed posture as the line-295 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: Attribute fallback reads BehaviorRestBindingAttribute and AppBehaviorAttribute metadata from runtime behavior types.
knownHazards.remediation: Move manual profile fallback metadata into generated descriptors or explicit module-provided descriptors before promoting Behaviors.Http beyond medium.

knownHazards.pattern: Profile binding validation resolves IAppBehavior<TInput,TOutput> and public input properties from runtime behavior/input types.
knownHazards.remediation: Feed input contract/property shape from source-generated descriptors or a host-provided binding contract instead of runtime type inspection.

knownHazards.pattern: Manual/type-based route contracts still resolve IAppBehavior<TInput,TOutput>, AppBehaviorAttribute, and Result<T>/BehaviorResult<T> payload generics from runtime behavior/output types.
knownHazards.remediation: Introduce generated or explicit endpoint-contract descriptors for manual/profile routes before changing the Behaviors.Http deployment-mode claim posture.

knownTransitiveHazards.comment: Known third-party packages that emit trim or AOT warnings even when the consuming Cephalon.* project itself looks clean. Listed for reference; the harness does not currently fail on these but reports them in the per-target warnings list so the operator can see the source.
